messages.subject: facets and facet label
parts:
I often find myself manipulating facet values to get the order I want.
Or I was until I discovered the labeller parameter, which gives me
separation of a sort of faceting and the labeling of facets. I wonder
if the possibility exists for something along the lines of

aggplot + facet_wrap(y ~ x, label=b ~ a)
